meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让一支敌对的多智能体团队在你把方案定稿前互相挑刺，提前暴露致命漏洞。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果重大方案即将拍板,你想在定稿前被彻底挑刺。
copy.tagline_en: Have adversarial agents cross-critique your plan before you lock it down.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a high-stakes plan is about to be locked and you want it stress-tested first.

howto.what: Claude 会当上 5 人对抗团队的 Lead:成员互相激烈攻击彼此的发现,只有经得起攻击的洞见被保留,再交给专门规划者成文。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度,或你要求做 hyperplan、对抗式、交叉批判式规划时触发;需处于 lead 会话且团队工具可用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次数据库迁移
用对抗式交叉批判的方式重做这个方案
say.note: 成员互相攻击后发现,再由规划者成文

say.text: 给这个计划最严格的审查,走 hyperplan

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Lead of a 5-member adversarial team: members ruthlessly attack each other's findings, only defensible insights survive, and a dedicated planner formalizes them into a plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when planning needs maximum rigor, or the user asks for a hyperplan, adversarial, or cross-critique plan. Requires a lead session with the team tools available.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this database migration.
say_en.note: It first says HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED! and forms a 5-member team.

say_en.text: Redo this proposal using adversarial cross-critique.
say_en.note: Members attack each other's findings, then a planner formalizes the survivors.

say_en.text: Give this plan the strictest review — run hyperplan.
say_en.note: Adversarial rounds run before the plan is written.
